outcome_evidence: The oven door is closed at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches and aligns with the door handle, then pulls the door outward and downward during frames 101–115. By frame 116, image and left_ego_image show the lowered door and exposed oven interior; the door remains open through frame 140 as the gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated objects is visibly established.
